title: Monomial-ideal tensor injectivity in a log regular chart
statement:
Let $P$ be a fine saturated commutative monoid, written additively, let $A$ be a commutative ring, and let $\alpha:P\to(A,\cdot)$ be a chart making $\operatorname{Spec}A$ a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth]. Write $\mathbf Z[P]=\bigoplus_{p\in P}\mathbf Zz^p$, with $z^pz^q=z^{p+q}$, and give $A$ its $\mathbf Z[P]$-algebra structure $z^p\mapsto\alpha(p)$. For every monoid ideal $H\subset P$ (meaning $H+P\subset H$), write $\mathbf Z[H]=\bigoplus_{h\in H}\mathbf Zz^h$, an ideal of $\mathbf Z[P]$. Then the multiplication map
$$A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[P]}\mathbf Z[H]\longrightarrow A,\qquad a\otimes z^h\longmapsto a\alpha(h),$$
is injective and has image the ideal $(\alpha(h):h\in H)$ of $A$. Tensor products are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product].

source.place: Expose VIII, proof of Lemma 3.4.3, printed p. 110, using Kato 1994, 6.1(ii); 3.5, printed p. 115, explicitly states the monomial Tor-independence theorem.

proof.text: Put $R=\mathbf Z[P]$ and $I=\mathbf Z[H]$. For each geometric point $\bar x$ of $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, apply [lem-trf-log-chart-strict-local-tor] to the given chart (without a sharpness assumption). It gives $\operatorname{Tor}^R_1(R/I,\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,\bar x})=0$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-tor-strict-henselian-detection] with this same $R\to A$, $M=R/I$ and $n=1$. Its local-Noetherian hypothesis is exactly the hypothesis on $\operatorname{Spec}A$. The vanishing at every geometric strict local ring from Step 1 therefore gives $\operatorname{Tor}^R_1(R/I,A)=0$.

source.place: Tag 07QM, lemma-dumb-properties-henselization (faithful flatness); combined with the fixed-base coefficient version of the free-resolution argument of algebra.tex, Tag 00M8, lemma-flat-base-change-tor, and localization in the coefficient ring. Re-split of the original second proof step.

proof.text: Compute Tor using the projective resolutions of [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]; the resolution of the free rank-one module $R$ concentrated in degree zero gives $\operatorname{Tor}^R_1(R,A)=0$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-tor-long-exact-first-variable] to $0\to I\to R\to R/I\to0$ with second argument $A$. Its exact segment identifies $\operatorname{Tor}^R_1(R/I,A)$ with the kernel of $I\otimes_R A\to R\otimes_R A$. Step 2 makes that kernel zero. The bilinear formulas $r\otimes a\mapsto ra$ and $i\otimes a\mapsto a\otimes i$, with their evident inverses, give $R\otimes_R A\cong A$ and tensor symmetry by [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. On $z^h\otimes a$ the induced map is $a\alpha(h)$, so it is the asserted multiplication map.

proof.text: The image is generated by the pure tensors a⊗z^h, whose images are aα(h), so it is exactly the ideal (α(h):h∈H). If H is empty, both the tensor source and this generated ideal are zero.

lean.statement: theorem logRegular_monomialIdeal_tensor_injective (X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (eA : X.scheme ≅ Spec (.of A)) (hlog : X.IsLogRegular) (P : Type u) [AddCommMonoid P] (hP : IsFineSaturatedMonoid (Multiplicative P)) (α : Multiplicative P →* A) (c : Multiplicative P →* X.logStructure.monoidSheaf.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X.scheme)))) (hc : X.logStructure.IsChart (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X.scheme)) c) (hα : ∀ p : P, X.logStructure.alpha.app (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X.scheme))) (c (Multiplicative.ofAdd p)) = eA.hom.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv (α (Multiplicative.ofAdd p)))) [Algebra (MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Multiplicative P)) A] (hAlg : algebraMap (MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Multiplicative P)) A = (MonoidAlgebra.lift ℤ A (Multiplicative P) α).toRingHom) (H : Set P) (hH : ∀ h ∈ H, ∀ p : P, h + p ∈ H) : Function.Injective (LinearMap.liftBaseChange A ((Algebra.linearMap (MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Multiplicative P)) A).comp (Ideal.span {z : MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Multiplicative P) | ∃ h ∈ H, z = MonoidAlgebra.single (Multiplicative.ofAdd h) 1}).subtype)) ∧ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.liftBaseChange A ((Algebra.linearMap (MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Multiplicative P)) A).comp (Ideal.span {z : MonoidAlgebra ℤ (Multiplicative P) | ∃ h ∈ H, z = MonoidAlgebra.single (Multiplicative.ofAdd h) 1}).subtype)) = (Ideal.span ((fun h : P ↦ α (Multiplicative.ofAdd h)) '' H) : Submodule A A)
